ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a contrast ratio of approximately 45:1 against high-intensity localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters concentrated at distal tips (left and right extremes); sparse, circular high-intensity points located in the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 42-degree angular divergence at the central vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing margin with peak-to-trough pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outward flare toward the distal tips from the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups at both distal fluke tips; isolated circular spots on the right lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological encrustation clusters at the distal extremities of both lobes.
